item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Food is fuel, and the choices you make early set the tone for the rest of the day. Eat at regular times, and don't let a busy schedule push meals to the margins. Build each plate around protein and vegetables, keep refined carbohydrates modest, and drink water first. Notice whether you're eating from hunger or from stress. Your evening routine goes better when dinner isn't rushed. Action: plan today's dinner right now, before hunger decides for you.
